source: segmentation (Blender simulation, background replaced by white)
units: pixels (x right, y DOWN from image top), seconds

camera.evidence: truck region mean |diff| vs frame 0 <= 1.6 grey levels over all 200 frames (only the box and flap change)
camera.perspective: near-orthographic side view; slight perspective: the falling box shows a thin strip of its underside (~25 px at frame 0, ~2 px at rest), so the camera is at about truck-roof height. No ground plane or horizon visible (white background).

objects.name: box
objects.description: brown cardboard box printed 'FRAGAIL' with umbrella/glass/arrows/recycle icons on its right part; one dark lid flap sticks up at its top-right corner (x~825-935) from ~frame 40 on
objects.reference_point: center_x, center_y = centre of the front face (face_left..face_right, face_top..face_bottom_left). Frames 0-27 the top is out of frame; center_y there = face_bottom_left - 95 (half the rest face height 190).

size_px.note: length 409-411 px constant in every frame; face height 189-190 in every unclipped frame

objects.name: truck
objects.description: white rigid-box catering/lift truck facing right; cab at right with white scissor-lift cage on the cab roof; two visible wheels

objects.name: flap
objects.description: dark/black flat panel appearing behind the left (rear) end of the truck, x 17-128, y 645-790; mostly hidden behind the truck's cargo box (its right part is occluded at x>=128)
objects.note: identity uncertain (likely a rear door / tail-lift part or a second dark object behind the truck); only its visible mask is tracked

events.note: center_y ~60-61 for frames 0-4 (out-of-frame top); downward motion becomes measurable from frame ~5 (t~0.042 s); consistent with release from rest at t=0

events.event: box lid flap starts to stick up

events.note: bottom-left reaches 399 at f60 and 403 (contact) at f61; last free-fall frame ~f59-60
face top rises 216->213 (2-3 px) over f62-70 then returns to 216 by f74

events.event: flap appears at left of truck
